data.notes:
#Tampa Bay's Modern IX

TBAX supports 10, 25, 100, 400 and 800g across our peering fabric.   We're able to provide redundancy (Multi-homing/LAG) into the fabric and PNNI vlan interconnect.  

Our network fully supports IPv6, including our route servers.  9000 Byte MTU is supported end to end standard.  

Our primary location is the Franklin Exchange, in the H5 Datacenter, 655 N Franklin St.  This makes cross connect to anywhere in the building via existing fiber simple via the building meet-me-room.  

The Franklin Exchange is the premier carrier hotel in Tampa Bay.
